versions.subject: new rules: Sigma rules based on Elastic rules (#3632)
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith: '\forfiles.exe'
selection_c:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - ' /c '
        - ' -c '
selection_p:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - ' /p '
        - ' -p '
selection_m:
    ParentCommandLine|contains:
        - ' /m '
        - ' -m '
filter:
    Image|endswith: '\cmd.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'xcopy'
        - 'cmd /c del'
condition: all of selection_* and not filter
versions.spl: ParentImage="*\\forfiles.exe" ParentCommandLine IN ("* /c *", "* -c *") ParentCommandLine IN ("* /p *", "* -p *") ParentCommandLine IN ("* /m *", "* -m *") NOT (Image="*\\cmd.exe" CommandLine="*xcopy*" CommandLine="*cmd /c del*")
